references.description: Illustration intégrale du modèle de Silent Hill (1999), reproduite dans la galerie Silent Hill Memories. Référence fournie à la génération.

prompt: Character-selection illustration for a Silent Hill 2D fighting game. One complete Air Screamer from the original 1999 Silent Hill, on a true transparent background. Use the supplied archival game publicity art as the visual identity reference. Create a front three-quarter character select pose with both wings raised and angling diagonally outward in a shallow V, showing the creature lifting its elongated blunt skull toward the viewer, slightly toward screen right. This clearly different airborne view is for the roster gallery. Preserve dirty brindled umber-brown hide, skin membranes and thin trailing scalloped edges, small trailing legs, exact compact torso and unusual short-faced pterosaur proportions from reference. No redesign, plumage, accessories, extra appendages, generic dragon horns or long tail. Restrained original 1999 survival-horror palette, strikingly detailed painted videogame art. Keep the entire figure, both feet, wingtips and skin margins legible with clean transparent space all around. Landscape 3:2, no floor/shadow, lettering or backdrop. Exactly one sprite, no sheet.
notes: Le portrait utilisait jusque-là la première image de l’animation idle. Illustration dédiée pour la sélection, ailes ouvertes en V et crâne de trois quarts. La silhouette et les textures constituent une interprétation à valider.
